title: OWASP Top 10:2021 - A01 Broken Access Control
content: Access control enforces policy such that users cannot act outside of their intended permissions. Failures typically lead to unauthorized information disclosure, modification, or destruction of all data, or performing a business function outside the user's limits. Common access control vulnerabilities include bypassing access control checks by modifying the URL, internal application state, or the HTML page; permitting viewing or editing someone else's account by providing its unique identifier (IDOR); and missing access controls for POST, PUT, and DELETE on administrative interfaces. Prevention requires enforcing access controls strictly in trusted server-side code, denying access by default, and implementing role-based access control mechanisms.
